intro: Navi Mumbai was planned node by node, and almost every sector in Vashi, Nerul, Belapur, Airoli and Kharghar has a garden or open space set aside for residents. Many of those spaces now need new play equipment, and the newer nodes need it for the first time. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai East, about 39 km away by road.

We have designed and built play equipment since 2002, with our own roto-moulding and fabrication units. For Navi Mumbai we send the equipment by road and install it with our own team. A housing society, school or builder deals with the manufacturer from the first drawing to the final bolt. You share the site size and photos, and we send back a layout with the safe play area marked.

sections.h: Sector gardens and society open spaces
sections.html:
A typical Navi Mumbai society has a recreation ground between buildings, often with an old slide and a swing frame that have rusted at the base. Replacing them is a good time to rethink the layout. One combined play station in the centre, with spring riders for toddlers on one side, uses the same space far better than scattered single pieces.

For societies that want a theme children will remember, our Robo Romp robot-themed stations pack slides and climbers into a compact footprint. Gardens shared by the whole sector need sturdier, simpler pieces that can take crowds every evening.

sections.h: Creek air, hill runoff and the monsoon
sections.html:
Much of Navi Mumbai sits between the Thane creek and the Parsik hills. Sites near the creek get damp, salty air, and those near the hills see heavy runoff in the monsoon from June to September. Both conditions are hard on bare steel.

Our posts are galvanised and our slides and panels are roto-moulded plastic, which does not rust. Place the play area on ground that drains towards the storm water line, not towards the building. After the rains, ask your housekeeping staff to tighten bolts and clear silt from under the spring riders.

sections.h: New towers in Kharghar, Ulwe and beyond
sections.html:
Builders in the newer nodes often place the children's area on a podium above parking. We use the self-standing method there, so the waterproofing on the slab is not disturbed, and lay rubber flooring over the podium surface. On natural ground we grout the posts into concrete.

If your project lies towards the Panvel side, our Panvel page covers that area. A layout drawing early in the design stage lets your architect fix drainage points and lighting around the play area before the podium is finished.

sections.h: A short drive from our factory
sections.html:
Being this close helps when a site has a narrow gate or a fixed handover date. Our installation crew can plan around your other contractors, and spare parts have only a short way to travel. Across the creek we have installed play equipment for Raymond in Thane.

Many societies here also want equipment for adults who use the garden for morning walks. Our outdoor gym equipment in Navi Mumbai page explains what fits beside a play area.

faq.q: Can you replace old playground equipment in our Navi Mumbai society?
faq.a: Yes. Send us photos of the existing equipment and the ground, with rough measurements. We suggest new pieces that fit the same space and send a layout with the safe play area marked. If you want, we remove the old frames when we install the new ones.

faq.q: Is your equipment safe to install on a podium slab?
faq.a: We use the self-standing method on podiums, which does not need deep holes in the slab. Rubber flooring over the podium cushions falls. Share the podium details with us early so your architect can confirm the load and drainage.

faq.q: How do you deal with the salty air near the creek?
faq.a: Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic resist rust far better than painted mild steel. Rinse the equipment with fresh water now and then, keep the drains clear and follow the maintenance steps we hand over after installation.

faq.q: Who installs the equipment in Navi Mumbai?
faq.a: Our own installation team, working from our factory in Vasai East, about 39 km away. We fix the posts by grouting or the self-standing method, depending on the ground, and walk your staff through basic care at handover.

intro: Thane is about 20 km from our factory in Vasai East, closer than any other large city we serve. It is also where we installed play equipment for Raymond, so a Thane buyer can see our work in their own city. FunPlay Systems has designed and manufactured outdoor playground equipment since 2002, and every piece for Thane is made in our 45,000 sq ft unit.

The city has two very different kinds of sites. The old centre around the lakes has established societies with small gardens and equipment that is due for replacement. Along Ghodbunder Road and Pokhran Road, large townships plan play areas that serve hundreds of families. We work with both, and with the schools and municipal gardens in between.

sections.h: Our project for Raymond in Thane
sections.html:
Our Raymond Thane project is a useful reference for builders and committees planning a large residential play area. It followed the same steps as any FunPlay job. We took the site details, drew a layout with the safe play area, and after approval we manufactured, dispatched and installed.

If you are a developer in Thane, ask us for the layout early. It is easier to plan drainage, lighting and seating around the play area before the garden work starts.

sections.h: Township play areas on Ghodbunder Road
sections.html:
A township garden has to serve toddlers, primary children and teenagers at once. We split it into zones. Low slides and spring riders go near the seating where parents sit, and a taller tower with climbing nets sits further away for older children.

For that taller tower, the NexLev Pinnacle tepee play towers give a strong centrepiece. Townships close to the Yeoor hills see heavy rain and dense tree cover. Leave space between the equipment and large trees, and keep the play surface clear of fallen branches.

sections.h: Replacing equipment in older societies
sections.html:
In Naupada, Panchpakhadi and the older parts of the city, many society gardens still have welded swings and slides from decades ago. Rust usually starts where the post meets the ground. Our galvanised posts are protected by a zinc coating along their whole length, and the play parts are roto-moulded in more than 15 colour shades.

Small gardens rarely fit more than a few pieces. Two swings and a compact slide unit, with rubber flooring underneath, is a sensible start that a committee can add to later.

sections.h: Nearby cities and adult fitness
sections.html:
Because Thane sits so close to our factory, our team often combines work here with sites in neighbouring cities such as Mira Bhayandar. Spare parts and after sales visits are simpler to arrange at this distance.

Thane's lakeside promenades and society gardens also draw walkers every morning. For exercise stations beside a play area, see our outdoor gym equipment in Thane.

faq.q: Have you installed playground equipment in Thane before?
faq.a: Yes. We installed play equipment for Raymond in Thane, and the project is listed on our website. Our factory in Vasai East is about 20 km away, so we can manufacture, deliver and install for Thane sites with our own team.

faq.q: Can you plan separate play zones in a large township?
faq.a: Yes. Tell us the garden size, how many families live there and the age groups you expect. We draw separate zones for toddlers and older children, mark the safe play area for each piece and show where seating can go.

faq.q: Our society garden is small and shaded by trees. What works?
faq.a: A few individual pieces placed clear of tree roots and low branches, such as swings, a spring rider and a small slide. Rubber flooring underneath stays usable in the rains. Send photos and we will suggest a layout.

faq.q: How do we reach your after sales team?
faq.a: Call +91 738 530 0921 or write to aftersales@funplaysystems.com, Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM. Share the site name and photos of the part that needs attention, and the team will guide you.

intro: Pune has more schools, colleges and new housing projects than most cities its size, and a large share of our Maharashtra enquiries come from here. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai East, about 140 km away. We send it over the ghats by road and install it with our own team or a local dealer.

Buyers in Pune tend to arrive with a clear brief. An architect may have marked the play area on a master plan, or a school may have a fixed ground and an age group in mind. We work from that brief, suggest equipment and send a drawing with the safe play area for each piece, so you can check the fit before you approve a quote.

sections.h: Schools in an education city
sections.html:
Pune schools often run nursery, primary and middle sections on one campus, with short breaks when many children come out together. Spreading them across several pieces works better than one large tower. Swings, see-saws and a merry-go-round take groups at once, and a separate corner for the youngest keeps them away from running feet.

Schools looking for something less common can use our Wall Play panels, which turn a boundary wall or a corridor into a place for puzzles and games.

sections.h: Gated communities in Baner, Wakad, Kharadi and Hadapsar
sections.html:
Most new projects in these areas plan a children's play area alongside the clubhouse and pool. Buyers notice it at the site visit, so builders want a piece that looks finished and stands up to daily use after possession.

Our NexLev Woody wooden structures suit landscaped gardens where the architect wants natural materials. For a podium, a roto-moulded play station on a self-standing base is the simpler choice. Projects across the river in Pimpri Chinchwad follow the same process.

sections.h: Deccan weather and ground
sections.html:
Pune is milder than Mumbai for much of the year, with cool winter mornings and dry heat in April and May. The monsoon is steady from June to September and heavier towards the western edge of the city. Galvanised posts and roto-moulded parts handle both the dry heat and the wet months.

Black soil in parts of the city swells when wet and cracks in summer. On such ground we grout posts into a proper concrete base so they stay level. Where the ground is rocky, we decide the method after seeing photos.

sections.h: Working with architects and consultants
sections.html:
Share the CAD plan or a marked site layout and we will place the equipment on it with the safe play area shown. That helps your garden consultant plan paving, planting and drainage around the playground at the same stage.

We can also propose colours from more than 15 roto-moulded shades to match the project palette. Adults in the same garden can use our outdoor gym equipment in Pune.

faq.q: Do you deliver and install playground equipment in Pune?
faq.a: Yes. We manufacture at our factory in Vasai East, about 140 km from Pune, send the equipment by road and install it with our own team or a local dealer. Tell us about the site gate and access road so we can plan the delivery.

faq.q: Can you work from our architect's drawings?
faq.a: Yes. Send the plan with the play area marked and the age groups you expect. We place the equipment on the drawing, show the safe play area for each piece and share a quote for your review.

faq.q: Which equipment suits a school with many children at break time?
faq.a: Pieces that take several children at once, such as multi-seat swings, see-saws and merry-go-rounds, spread across the ground. A separate zone for nursery children keeps them apart from older pupils. We can show this on a layout.

faq.q: Do you offer wooden playground equipment?
faq.a: Yes. Our NexLev Woody range uses wood, and some of our other ranges use wooden and composite parts. Wooden structures suit landscaped gardens. Ask us about the care they need in Pune's monsoon before you choose.

intro: Pimpri Chinchwad grew around factories, and many of its residential areas started as housing for people working in the automobile and engineering units of Bhosari, Chinchwad and the nearby industrial belt. Today the city also has large new housing projects in Wakad, Ravet, Punawale and Moshi. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to both, from our factory in Vasai East, about 130 km away.

We understand buyers who think like engineers, because we fabricate our own frames and roto-mould our own parts. Since 2002 we have built play equipment for schools, builders, companies and public bodies across India. For a Pimpri Chinchwad site, we send the equipment by road and install it with our team or a local dealer.

sections.h: Company colonies and staff housing
sections.html:
Many company townships in and around the city have a central garden that has seen years of use. When the equipment needs replacing, the facility team usually wants pieces that are simple to maintain and easy to buy spares for. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts need only cleaning and periodic bolt checks.

Our spring riders, swings and see-saws suit these gardens, since they can be added one at a time as budget allows. We keep the full layout on one drawing so each new piece has its place and safe area planned.

sections.h: New projects in Wakad, Ravet and Moshi
sections.html:
Builders in the western and northern parts of the city usually plan a play area beside the clubhouse or on the podium. A themed multi play station gives the brochure a strong picture and keeps children busy after possession. We use the self-standing method on podiums and grouting on open ground.

If your project is nearer the Pune side of the boundary, see our Pune page. The planning process is the same in both cities.

sections.h: Choosing the surface under the equipment
sections.html:
The surface matters as much as the equipment. Packed earth turns hard in the dry months and muddy during the June to September rains. Grass wears away under swings and slides within a season.

Rubber flooring cushions falls, drains quickly and stays in shape, and we can supply it with the play equipment. If you prefer sand in one part of the garden, keep it to a defined pit with an edging, and plan to top it up after the monsoon.

sections.h: Parks and public gardens
sections.html:
Gardens run by the Pimpri Chinchwad Municipal Corporation see families every evening and on weekends. They need equipment that stays firm under heavy use, so we grout posts into concrete there. Merry-go-rounds and multi-seat swings take several children at once.

For walkers and senior citizens in the same garden, our outdoor gym equipment in Pimpri Chinchwad page covers exercise stations that can sit beside a play area.

faq.q: Can we buy playground equipment in stages for our township?
faq.a: Yes. We prepare one layout for the whole garden with the safe play area for every piece, and you can order part of it now and the rest later. Each new piece then fits without disturbing what is already installed.

faq.q: Which surface should we use under the play equipment?
faq.a: Rubber flooring is the most practical choice for most sites in Pimpri Chinchwad. It cushions falls, drains quickly in the rains and does not turn hard in summer. We can supply and lay it with the equipment.

faq.q: How far is your factory from Pimpri Chinchwad?
faq.a: Our factory is in Vasai East, Palghar district, about 130 km away. We make all the equipment there, send it by road and install it with our own team or a local dealer.

faq.q: Are spare parts available after the warranty?
faq.a: Yes. Contact our after sales team on +91 738 530 0921 with photos of the part. Springs, bearings and spare parts carry a one-year warranty, and after that the team can arrange replacements for you.

intro: Raipur is the capital of Chhattisgarh, and with Nava Raipur rising on its eastern side, the city has new government campuses, public spaces and housing projects that need play areas. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai East, about 930 km away, and sends it east by road through Vidarbha.

We have been designing and manufacturing play equipment since 2002 and have more than 15,000 installations across India. In Raipur, installation is done by our own team or a dealer in central India. Schools, housing societies, builders and municipal bodies all start the same way. Send us the site size, the age group and a few photos, and we reply with a layout drawing and a quote.

sections.h: Planning a playground for Raipur's heat
sections.html:
Raipur's summer is long and harsh, and children use outdoor equipment mostly in the early morning and after sunset from March to June. Plan the play area where buildings or trees throw shade in the evening. A shade sail over the main deck extends the hours it can be used.

Choose lighter colours for slides and seats, as dark plastic absorbs more heat. Roto-moulded parts hold their colour well in strong sun. Galvanised posts handle the heavy monsoon that follows without rusting.

sections.h: New public spaces in Nava Raipur
sections.html:
Planned areas usually come with wide gardens and open plots, which leaves room for larger equipment. A circus-themed station from our Clown Capade range can anchor a public garden, with swings and see-saws around it for overflow on busy evenings.

Public tenders often ask for a site layout and clear details of materials and warranty. We provide the drawing with safe play areas marked and state the warranty in writing. It runs three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts.

sections.h: Schools, societies and the steel belt
sections.html:
Private schools in Raipur often have open grounds where nursery and primary children need separate play corners. Housing societies on the city's growing edges want a compact play station near the entrance or clubhouse.

The steel towns to the west have their own plant townships and schools. We supply Bhilai and nearby cities in the same way, and our Chhattisgarh page covers the rest of the state.

sections.h: Installation over a long distance
sections.html:
A Raipur site is a long road trip from Vasai, so we plan the dispatch carefully. Before the truck leaves, confirm that the base is ready, the ground is level and someone on site can receive the material. That avoids a crew waiting on a site that is not prepared.

For residents and walkers who want exercise equipment as well, see our outdoor gym equipment in Raipur.

faq.q: Do you supply playground equipment to Raipur?
faq.a: Yes. We manufacture at our factory in Vasai East, send the equipment about 930 km by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in central India. We plan dispatch once your site and base are ready.

faq.q: Can you support a government or municipal tender in Raipur?
faq.a: We can share a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, the equipment list, material details and our written warranty terms. Send us the tender requirements and site details, and our sales team will tell you what we can provide.

faq.q: Which colours suit strong sun?
faq.a: Lighter shades stay cooler to the touch than dark ones, and roto-moulded plastic holds its colour well. We offer more than 15 shades. Pair them with shade over the main deck for afternoon comfort.

faq.q: What should be ready on site before installation?
faq.a: A cleared, levelled area of the size shown on our layout, safe access for the truck and someone to receive the material. Where we grout posts, the team needs room to dig and pour concrete.

/outdoor-playground-equipment-manufactur.notes: Mentioned Nava Raipur by name (the planned new capital area); no specific projects or roads named. The route 'through Vidarbha' is a geographic description of the road from Vasai to Raipur via Nagpur.

intro: Rajasthan asks more of outdoor equipment than most states. Summer afternoons in the Thar are among the hottest in India, dust storms sweep across the west before the monsoon, and desert nights in winter turn cold. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures playground equipment that is chosen and placed with these conditions in mind. We supply schools, resorts, housing projects and public gardens across the state from our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra.

The equipment travels north by road through Gujarat and is installed by our own team or a dealer in the region. We have been making play equipment since 2002, with design, roto-moulding and fabrication done in-house. Our galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic stand up to heat, dust and the short, heavy rains. Every project begins with your site size, the age group and photos, and a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

sections.h: Desert, Aravallis and the eastern plains
sections.html:
Western Rajasthan, around Jodhpur, Bikaner and Jaisalmer, is dry desert country. Here the questions are heat, glare and blowing sand, and the sun is strong for most of the year. Place slides and decks away from the afternoon sun, choose lighter colours and wash the equipment often so sand does not grind the surfaces.

The Aravalli belt around Udaipur is greener and hilly, with rocky ground that often suits grouting. Jaipur and the eastern plains around Kota have very hot summers, a stronger monsoon and cold winter mornings, so drainage and a raised base matter more there.

sections.h: Who buys play equipment in Rajasthan
sections.html:
Heritage hotels, palace resorts and wedding venues want a play corner that looks at home on a lawn or in a courtyard. Our Timeless Play structures, based on traditional games, sit well in such settings.

Schools are a large share of buyers, from city schools in Jaipur to residential schools in smaller towns. Kota, with its many students and families, has steady demand for society and school play areas. Industrial colonies in textile towns such as Bhilwara and Pali, and municipal gardens across the state, need durable pieces that take daily use with little upkeep.

faq.q: Do you deliver playground equipment anywhere in Rajasthan?
faq.a: Yes. We manufacture at our factory in Vasai, send the equipment by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in the region. Share your town, site photos and access details so we can plan the dispatch.

faq.q: How do we stop the equipment getting too hot in a Rajasthan summer?
faq.a: Place slides and decks where buildings or trees shade them in the afternoon, add a shade sail over the main structure and choose lighter colours. Rubber flooring stays more comfortable than bare stone or concrete.

faq.q: Does dust damage playground equipment?
faq.a: Sand and dust wear down slide surfaces and get into moving parts if left for long. Wash the equipment with plain water regularly, more often after a dust storm, and have springs and bearings checked every few months.

faq.q: Can you design a play area for a heritage hotel or resort?
faq.a: Yes. We can customise designs and colours from more than 15 roto-moulded shades, and some of our ranges use wooden and composite parts. Send us photos of the lawn or courtyard and we will suggest pieces that suit the setting.

/outdoor-playground-equipment-manufactur.notes: State page with no km in the fact sheet, so no distance given. Route described only as 'north by road through Gujarat'. Bikaner, Jaisalmer, Bhilwara and Pali mentioned as places only, without links (Bhilwara and Pali have pages in nearby but links kept to 4).

intro: Vadodara sits on the same national highway as our factory in Vasai East, about 330 km to the north. That straight road makes Gujarat's third city an easy one for us to supply. FunPlay Systems has designed and manufactured outdoor playground equipment since 2002, and we bring it to Vadodara by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in west India.

The city mixes an old cultural centre, a large university and an industrial belt with refineries and engineering units. Buyers here include schools, the Vadodara Municipal Corporation and other public bodies, company townships and builders on the western edge of the city. Each starts with a layout drawing from us that shows the equipment and the safe play area around it.

sections.h: Planning around monsoon flooding
sections.html:
When the Vishwamitri river rises in a heavy monsoon, low-lying parts of Vadodara can stay under water for a day or more. Before you place a play area, find out how high water reached on your site in past years. Raise the base above that level if you can, and slope it towards a drain.

Galvanised posts and roto-moulded plastic parts survive standing water far better than painted steel. After a flood, wash off the mud, check that posts are still firm and call our after sales team if any part looks damaged.

sections.h: Housing in Gotri, Bhayli and Vasna
sections.html:
The western side of the city has seen many new apartment and bungalow projects. Builders there usually want a play area that is ready for the sample flat visit, and residents want it to last for years after.

For a lawn with some trees, our Organic Play structures blend with planting better than a bright plastic tower. Projects with a podium can use a roto-moulded play station on a self-standing base. Many Vadodara societies also want an open-air gym for adults, and our outdoor gym equipment in Vadodara page covers that.

sections.h: Schools, campuses and company townships
sections.html:
Schools in Vadodara often share their ground for sports days and festival events, including garba during Navratri. Keep the play equipment along one side so the main ground stays open, and grout it firmly so it stays put when crowds gather.

Company townships near the industrial estates need gardens for staff families. Here a simple set of swings, see-saws and a merry-go-round serves many children with little maintenance.

sections.h: Supplying the rest of central Gujarat
sections.html:
Equipment for Vadodara comes from the same factory and follows the same steps as for any site. You approve the layout and quote, we manufacture at Vasai, and the truck travels up the highway to your site.

We also serve Ahmedabad, Anand and Nadiad. Summers across central Gujarat are very hot, so plan shade over slides and decks wherever children will play in the afternoon.

faq.q: Do you supply and install playground equipment in Vadodara?
faq.a: Yes. We manufacture at our factory in Vasai East, about 330 km away, send the equipment by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in west India.

faq.q: Our site floods in heavy rain. Can we still have a playground?
faq.a: Yes, with some planning. Raise the play area above the usual flood level, give it a slope towards a drain and use galvanised and roto-moulded equipment. Clean and check it after any flooding.

faq.q: Can play equipment stay on a ground used for garba?
faq.a: Yes. Place it along one edge of the ground, grouted into concrete, and keep the open area free for events. We mark the safe play area on the layout so stages and seating are not set up too close.

faq.q: What do you need from us to prepare a quote?
faq.a: The length and width of the play area, the age group of the children and a few photos of the site. Mention any flooding or drainage problems so we can account for them in the layout.

/outdoor-playground-equipment-manufactur.notes: Vishwamitri flooding of low-lying areas is a well-known recurring issue; no dates or figures used. Gotri, Bhayli and Vasna named as western residential areas.

intro: Vijayawada lies on the Krishna river, a busy commercial and education city in coastal Andhra Pradesh, with Guntur and the state capital region close by. Its schools, apartment projects and public gardens need play equipment that copes with fierce summer heat and the heavy rain that cyclones from the Bay of Bengal can bring. FunPlay Systems supplies them from our factory in Vasai East, about 880 km away.

We have designed and manufactured outdoor playground equipment since 2002. For Vijayawada, the equipment goes by road and is installed by our own team or a dealer in south India. You tell us the site size and the children's age group and send photos, and we reply with suggested equipment, a layout drawing with the safe play area marked and a quote.

sections.h: Summer heat and cyclone rain
sections.html:
Vijayawada's summer, from March to June, is one of the hottest in south India, and the air stays humid. Place the play area where it gets shade in the afternoon, and plan a shade structure over the main deck. Roto-moulded plastic in lighter shades stays cooler and holds its colour.

Later in the year, depressions and cyclones over the Bay of Bengal can bring days of heavy rain. Galvanised posts and plastic parts do not rust, but the base needs to drain. A raised platform with rubber flooring dries quickly once the rain stops.

sections.h: Schools with large enrolments
sections.html:
Vijayawada is known for its schools and coaching institutions, and many campuses have hundreds of young children on the ground at break time. Equipment that takes groups at once helps. Multi-seat swings, see-saws and merry-go-rounds keep the queue short.

For kindergarten and primary sections, our Kagzi structures, based on paper folding shapes such as boats and planes, give younger children something to climb and crawl through. Keep the nursery zone separate from older pupils.

sections.h: Apartments, gardens and the capital region
sections.html:
Builders across the city and on the roads towards Guntur plan play areas for new apartment blocks. A compact multi play station near the clubhouse suits most of them. Gardens maintained by the Vijayawada Municipal Corporation need sturdy pieces grouted firmly into concrete.

We also supply Guntur and other towns in the Krishna and Guntur districts. Our Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh page covers the wider region.

sections.h: Exercise equipment beside the play area
sections.html:
Many Vijayawada families use society gardens and riverside walkways in the early morning and late evening, when the heat eases. An outdoor gym next to the children's area lets parents and grandparents exercise while they keep an eye on the children.

Our outdoor gym equipment in Vijayawada page lists stations that fit beside a playground. We can show both on one layout drawing with the safe areas marked.

faq.q: Do you install playground equipment in Vijayawada?
faq.a: Yes. We manufacture at our factory in Vasai East, about 880 km away, send the equipment by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in south India. We plan dispatch once your base is ready.

faq.q: How can children use the equipment in Vijayawada's summer?
faq.a: Shade is the key. Place the play area where buildings or trees cover it in the afternoon, add a shade structure over the main deck and use lighter colours. Most children will play in the morning and evening in any case.

faq.q: Will heavy cyclone rain damage the equipment?
faq.a: Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic handle long spells of rain well. The bigger risk is standing water around the posts, so build a raised, well-drained base and check the bolts once the weather clears.

faq.q: What warranty comes with your equipment?
faq.a: Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry three years, and springs, bearings and spare parts carry one year. The cover is for manufacturing defects, with installation and maintenance done as we instruct.
